subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw approve the 14 updated third-party GitHub Action revisions for workflows that access repository credentials, release publishing, and security automation?
rationale: This is a trust-boundary decision about upstream executable workflow code, not a mechanical repository-side defect that automation can safely repair.

options.title: Approve the reviewed revisions
options.body: Verify each updated SHA against the intended upstream release and approve the workflow dependency refresh.

options.title: Pause for upstream review
options.body: Leave the PR open until a workflow/security owner can validate the affected action releases and their execution scope.

recommendation.title: Approve the reviewed revisions
recommendation.body: Verify each updated SHA against the intended upstream release and approve the workflow dependency refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only concrete review-routing signal in the provided history; a human workflow/security owner should make the decision.
